description: Implementation of ue_drx_controller class managing Discontinuous Reception (DRX) logic for a UE in a 3GPP-based network, including timers, slot indications, and activity state management.

classes.name: ue_drx_controller
classes.description: Class managing DRX state, timers, and activity detection for a UE.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures DRX parameters based on new configuration.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot indication events to update active time window.

methods.name: is_pdcch_enabled
methods.description: Checks if PDCCH is enabled based on DRX state.

methods.name: is_active_time
methods.description: Determines if the UE is in active time.

methods.name: update_inactivity_timer
methods.description: Updates inactivity timer based on received slot.

methods.name: on_new_dl_pdcch_alloc
methods.description: Handles new downlink PDCCH allocation events.

methods.name: on_new_ul_pdcch_alloc
methods.description: Handles new uplink PDCCH allocation events, including retransmission timers.

methods.name: on_dl_harq_nack
methods.description: Handles HARQ NACK events to update timers.

methods.name: on_con_res_start
methods.description: Starts contention resolution timer based on UL-CCCH slot.
